title: Muslim League announces Direct Action programme
detail: After political deadlock around the Cabinet Mission framework, the Muslim League declared that 16 August would be observed as Direct Action Day.

title: Hartal and rally in Calcutta turn violent
detail: In Bengal, a public holiday and large mobilization in Calcutta were followed by escalating street clashes, reprisals, and organized communal attacks.

title: Great Calcutta Killing devastates the city
detail: For days, Calcutta saw mass killings, arson, looting, and retaliatory violence between communities. Historical accounts vary on precise casualty totals, but agree on very large-scale loss of life and displacement.

title: Communal violence spreads beyond Calcutta
detail: Later in 1946, major communal massacres in regions including Noakhali and Bihar deepened fear, revenge cycles, and political separation.

title: Partition politics harden in Bengal
detail: The 1946 violence became one of the strongest arguments used by competing political camps that coexistence had failed, reinforcing momentum toward Bengal's partition in 1947.
